restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.summary: Glory Days states that normal operations can cause allergen cross-contact and that deep-fried foods carry high cross-contact risk; guests with allergies should speak with a manager.
The North menu says shared fryers cook multiple foods including seafood and shellfish, except designated gluten-free fryers, and the kitchen cannot be guaranteed allergen-free.

summary: The Lorton location is confirmed by the official location page and uses the current North-region 2026 menu plus the current kids menu. The frozen packet is severely smeared across Florida nutrition/allergen material, North and South menu text, option expansions, calorie fragments, headings, alcohol, and duplicate presentations. The official Food Allergies link currently resolves to a Florida-named matrix whose catalog does not match Lorton, so no applicable Lorton/North matrix was found after all four required searches. Explicit North-menu ingredient positives and the restaurant’s direct shared-fryer/cross-contact warning are preserved without treating the Florida matrix as Lorton evidence.
